pipelines.notes: Article/news dispatcher evaluates Source due state every six hours. It polls only due Sources under source_collection_cadence.json; partial Source failure remains visible but does not make an otherwise useful cycle a total scheduler failure.

Continuous Newsroom Intake V1 (2026-09-01). Every 4 hours: Google News RSS discovery + qualification, then the pulse-to-Publication intake bridge (novelty check, bounded body acquisition, Publication draft creation) so a qualifying story can reach Publication Review and the Front Page's Emerging/Unreviewed section without a human clicking Run Pulse first. Lock-protected against overlap with itself (app/services/industry_pulse/newsroom_cycle.py's own lock, separate from the main collection lock -- pulse discovery and per-Source RSS polling are independent resources). Never writes trusted Evidence, never onboards a Source, never bypasses Publication Review. Perplexity catch-net stays a separate, explicit ENABLE_PERPLEXITY_PULSE opt-in -- not baked into this runner string by default. DELIBERATELY DISABLED as of 2026-09-01 (enabled: false): production's own trusted-freshness-funnel audit found 1,710 Publication drafts pending review against 3 ever published and one recorded review decision in all of history -- review throughput, not discovery volume, is the bottleneck. Recurring intake adds more volume to an already-unclearable queue. Re-enable only once a current-priority review/triage workflow exists and can demonstrably keep pace with arrival rate (see the queued Trusted Freshness Recovery + Review Triage V1 mission's own explicit activation gate). Until then, run manually via POST /industry-pulse/run or `python scripts/industry_pulse_intake.py` for bounded/operator-mode use.

Background NewsCatcher CatchAll recall. Base mode is 10-15 minutes and must never run on request-time /week. This job writes normalized hits to inbox/operations/catchall_recall/cache.json; /week consumes already-fetched rows. Without NEWSCATCHER_API_KEY or CATCHALL_API_KEY the runner succeeds as awaiting_key — SET the env var and the next scheduled run becomes live. No Publication drafts. No Evidence writes.
Weekly bounded import of the official USDA PVPO Application Status XLSX. Berry rows only. Inbox Variety candidates. No automatic canonical identity merge. No Evidence writes.

Background Emerging Developments Radar refresh. Bounded Google + specialist RSS + Exa semantic themes (not Pulse 32, not APITube, never a live CatchAll submit). Writes inbox/operations/radar/cache.json so /radar is instant. LIVE / UNREVIEWED only. No Evidence writes.
